note: RFC 9012 Section 4.2, rfc/full/rfc9012.txt:1181-1190: "In case of such a conflict, the information in the Router's MAC Extended Community MUST be used." The preceding sentence describes differing router MAC values in that community and a VXLAN/NVGRE Encapsulation sub-TLV. No tagged carriers exist for this row. Independently read SubTLVs and checkRouteBestChange: opaque values can coexist and conflict, but neither producer compares these MAC sources or chooses the community's MAC for encapsulation. Election exports next hop, metrics, NLRI labels and attribute-40 SRv6 metadata, not an attribute-23-derived encapsulation MAC; scoped FIB/sysrib/RIB search reveals no such consumer. Opaque receipt is implemented, selected-MAC behavior remains absent, and no tagged test verifies it. Retain unimplemented and both guard keys under plan/post-release/features/spec-bgp-tunnel-encapsulation-consumption.md; conflicting legal input is possible, so not-applicable would be unjustified.
